messages.subject: score
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I expect to have always a negative BN score for any network. As it is
the log of the score and the metric is a probability function (so the
score will be btw 0 and 1). And the log of it will always be negative.
So can anybody explain me how it is possible to get a positive score?

Many thanks,

Nil

messages.subject: Re: Re: jointprior error
messages.body_plain:
Hello ( or Merhaba ?) Mehmet ,

You are right, I immediately think your problem is related to what i  
said as i had such problem (and other ppl as well, cf archive).
I remember i wanted to insert arrows automatically, and i was having  
similar problem.You may want to consider trying this:

#==========================================================#
nw <- network(data.frame(d))
#nw <- getnetwork(insert(nw,2,1,nocalc=TRUE)) ##don t add this arrow
prior <- jointprior(nw)

#is this work?
#if yes, try this:
#specify the arrow interactively:
nw<-network(data.frame(d),specifygraph = TRUE,inspectprob = TRUE)
prior <- jointprior(nw)


I hope this helps,

PS: if you want to use with discrete variable, you may want to try  
Banjo as well.

Best,

Nil

Actually I want to score a large number of different directed acyclic graphs
that are in the form of adjacency matrices. So what I am doing is first
I insert all the edges to an empty network and then I score it.
Because of this large number of graphs, I can not use deal interactively.
And all of the variables in the graphs are continuous.
So any ideas about this? Or maybe another R package that can do this?

Thanks,
Mehmet
